improvements: Lock observation now requires identifying four visible water/boat stages using explicit controls; visitors do not operate the real lock equipment.
Source buildings retain exact footprints, courtyard holes and shared native roofs. Mathematical capsule-pole degenerates were removed without dropping boats.
Mapped north-bank public ways w60973303/w472179831 and mapped western access/steps retain exact XY and now connect at the existing coping grade. Width/grade are explicit unmeasured estimates.
The fourth board reader and lock-observation point follow the mapped path bend. All4 boards, observation and postcard are reached in one continuous native walk; source membership remains unchanged.
remainingGaps: Gate/walkway widths, fish-ladder placement, garden paths and water datums need matched source and official reference comparisons.
The public path grade 0.6m, width 3.2m and western steps width 2.6m are estimates aligned with the existing authored coping, not field or aerial height/width measurements.
The context harness180m planning bound returns no route; the independently bounded native 181m plan completes.
The changed terrain signature invalidates the old source-geometry cache; 107 volumes are correctly recomputed. Final cache rebake remains pending.

Raw post-walk audit reports 1phantom on the unchanged long south lock wall. Direct native mesh rays confirm its handrail; the auditor excludes long triangle boxes above 120m. Raw finding is retained for owner review.
